# Spyglass Insurance Agency

> Spyglass Insurance Agency, LLC is an independent property and casualty insurance agency in Austin, Texas. It compares available options from multiple insurance carriers for Texas homeowners, drivers, renters, landlords and small businesses, and explains coverage in plain English. It is the sister company of Spyglass Realty, an Austin real estate brokerage.

- Legal name: Spyglass Insurance Agency, LLC
- Licensing: Texas Department of Insurance General Lines Agency License #3532029 · NPN 22307568
- Address: 8501 N Mopac Expy STE 110, Austin, TX 78759
- Phone: (512) 598-9701
- Email: insurance@spyglassinsurance.com
- Website: https://spyglassinsurance.com
- Sister company: Spyglass Realty (https://www.spyglassrealty.com/)

Coverage discussed on the site: homeowners, auto, umbrella, landlord, flood, renters and commercial insurance. All coverage is subject to carrier eligibility and underwriting; site content is educational, not a quote or policy language.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://spyglassinsurance.com/): overview of coverage, how the independent agency works, and quote request form
- [Homeowners insurance in Austin, Texas](https://spyglassinsurance.com/homeowners-insurance): what Texas homeowners policies typically cover and what to read closely
- [Flood insurance in Austin and Central Texas](https://spyglassinsurance.com/flood-insurance): NFIP vs. private flood, waiting periods, lender requirements
- [Learning center](https://spyglassinsurance.com/learning): plain-English insurance guides for Texas homeowners and buyers
- [What every Texas homebuyer should know about insurance](https://spyglassinsurance.com/learning/texas-homebuyer-homeowners-insurance)
- [Why Texas homeowners insurance rates change](https://spyglassinsurance.com/learning/why-texas-homeowners-rates-change)
- [Do you need flood insurance in Central Texas?](https://spyglassinsurance.com/learning/flood-insurance-central-texas)
